calls.reason: Grammarly, Samsung, Bard and Meta sources show precedents for writing, transcription, image editing, personal-data retrieval and generated stickers, but nothing shows equivalents for onscreen awareness and cross-app actions.
The court filing shows OpenAI cut its adoption forecast, but no evidence shows a service agreement or capacity reserved for Apple, let alone idle capacity. The premise was speculative.
iOS 18 launched Sept 2024 but Apple's announcement shows the ChatGPT integration arrived in December. No deal-level revenue or cost account at launch exists in the packet.

CNBC reported an expected 2024 loss of about $5B on $3.7B revenue, and Ars Technica reports audited 2024 figures showing a net loss just over $5B, so 'deeply unprofitable' held. The per-search clause is unscorable.
No evidence shows the Apple integration reached hundreds of millions of actual users. AppleInsider reports users preferred the standalone app, and no integration-specific cost data exists.

Apple's own foundation-model disclosure says it trained on licensed data plus public web data collected by AppleBot. It treats the crawled data as separate from licensed data, which supports that training was not licensed-only.
